text: From water, life begins; from the land, the future grows.
In Sudan, farming meets technology, and resources meet opportunity.
Sudagri... connecting agriculture with trade, and creating new opportunities for a more prosperous future.
With the first drop... a new season begins.
Endless sun... and water without fuel.
Know your land... before you plant it.
Land without end... waiting for the plough.
White gold... falling seed by seed.
Gum arabic... from the hashab tree to the world.
Karkadeh... the red colour of Sudan.
From the palms of the Northern State... a blessing that never ends.
Next year's seed... is saved today.
Camels... wealth that walks the land.
Care that reaches the herd... wherever it is.
And from the Nile... a living every morning.
Nafir... when one of us calls, everyone comes. Values the countryside lives before they are ever written.
A field that takes one man a week... is harvested in a day by many hands.
The canal belongs to all... so all of us clear it. And when the water flows, everyone knows their turn.
There is no wage in nafir... only the shared meal, and a debt repaid at the neighbour's nafir.
Judiyya... the wisdom of the elders. A dispute settled with a kind word, so the land and the neighbours remain.
Shura... the leader is questioned in public, and answers in public.
And how the returns are shared is announced... before planting, not after.
Leading by example... I ask no one for work I do not share. The land is a trust, and building it is worship.
"If the Hour comes and one of you holds a seedling, let him plant it"... we work, even if we never see the fruit.
When I make a promise, I keep it... and it counts as kept when the other side says so, not when I do.
Excellence... I do my work as if people will see it, because they will.
We do not import values... we give our own a wider tool. Nafir on Sudagri: a call is posted, and people answer it by name.
From the field to the table... value added at home.
When we agree... we grow more, and sell better.
Your information, in your hand... wherever you are.
At the end of the day... he knows his crop's price, and when his water comes.
And he shows her the whole market... in the palm of his hand.
And from the field to the market... a fair price, and a trader you know.
From the fields of Sudan... to the markets of the world.
Sudagri... growing the future, together.
"The believers to one another are like a building, each part holding up the other."
One nafir... one land... one future we grow together.
Far from home… yet your heart is in the land of Sudan.
And in Sudan, there is wide, fertile land… waiting for a partner like you!

The Sudagri idea is simple: the landowner brings the land, the investor brings the money… and if you both wish, a farming company runs the season. The platform brings you together, verifies, and witnesses.
The landowner brings the land and its water… and it is shown to no one until the platform verifies its papers.
And you bring the money, and see the verified land: its size, its water, and its soil.
And you can ask for an independent inspection… before you decide.
And if you are not there… a trusted partner company runs the farming, for a share of the net profit.
You message each other on the platform… and choose the partnership that suits you:
Sharing the crop, renting, financing, or musaqah orchard care… or a three-way partnership run by a company.
Then a written contract, signed by everyone on the platform… with Sudagri as its witness, under its own number.
And the season is documented stage by stage, with photo and date… you follow it from wherever you are!
Until the harvest… and the yield is shared between you, as you wrote.
Land you can trust, a partner you know, and a season you see with your own eyes.
Sudagri… partner in the land of Sudan. Start today!
